scope: Backend model, serializer, JobApplicationActivity, PlatoOverviewCallout, PlatoLoadingState

backendModel.details: broadcast_status_change uses before_update callback with status_changed? (correct for pre-save dirty tracking). after_commit callbacks use saved_change_to_status? (correct for post-save dirty tracking). job_application and job_application.job are non-optional belongs_to associations, so nil is impossible at callback time. rescue StandardError on the broadcast prevents callback failures from aborting the save. BROADCAST_STATUSES constant correctly excludes pending, awaiting_job_criteria, retrying. update_columns(status: 'current') on AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus works correctly because Rails 6.1 update_columns passes values through the type system including enum mapping (confirmed by analog: board_wwr_listing.rb:203 uses update_columns(status: 'canceled') with an integer enum column).

serializer.details: has_one :ai_job_application_summary_status on the serializer delegates to JobApplication's has_one :ai_job_application_summary_status association. When no status record exists, serializer returns null. Matches the analog pattern in ShallowJobApplicationSerializer. AiJobApplicationSummaryStatusSerializer serializes id, ai_job_application_summary_id, status, score_percentage, headline, integrated_role_analysis, updated_at -- all columns confirmed present in db/schema.rb.

jobApplicationActivity.details: Conditional on line 399 uses optional chaining (?.status) which returns undefined when aiJobApplicationSummaryStatus is null -- correctly falls through to PlatoOverviewCallout. Props passed to PlatoGeneratedReviewCallout (headline, roleFit, scorePct, generatedAgo) use || fallbacks for safety (|| '', || '', || 0, distanceInWords). distanceInWords receives updatedAt which is always present when status is current/regenerating. Props passed to PlatoOverviewCallout (summaryStatusValue, hasResume) are correctly sourced from the status record.

platoOverviewCallout.details: deriveCalloutStatus handles all input combinations correctly: current/regenerating return null (component returns null, parent renders PlatoGeneratedReviewCallout instead); null/undefined/none with resume returns 'ask'; null/undefined/none without resume returns 'noResume'; unexpected values fall through to 'ask' (defensive). The component is only rendered when status is NOT current/regenerating (per parent conditional), so the current/regenerating null returns are defensive only.

platoLoadingState.details: Monotonic advancement via Math.max(prev, target) in useEffect is correct. STATUS_TO_STEP maps pipeline statuses to step indices correctly per spec. Unmapped statuses (retrying, awaiting_job_criteria, succeeded, failed) produce target=null, effect is a no-op, checklist holds position. Initial state defaults to step 1 when no status is mapped, which is reasonable (skips 'Processing the resume' if component mounts before first status). prefers-reduced-motion media query disables spinner animation for accessibility.
